senses.gloss: m. pl. (of זוֹנֶה; זָנָה) [degenerate wheat,] a weed growing among wheat, darnel or rye-grass (Lolium perenne, v. Löw Pfl. p. 133).
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Kilayim 1:1">Kil. I, 1</cite>. Y. ib. 26ᵈ <he>מין הטין וכ׳</he> they (zonin) are a kind of wheat, only that fruits degenerate, v. <cite ref="G00569"><he>זָנָה</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Tosefta Terumot 6:10">Tosef. Ter. VI, 10</cite> <he>ז׳ שבה</he> (Var. <he>זוגין</he>) the darnel in it; Y. ib. V, end, 43ᵈ <he>ז׳ טנופת</he> (strike out <cite ref="I00001"><he>ט׳</he></cite> as a gloss).
